card1_example: Marketing leaders who need a WordPress agency for a project this quarter
card1_body: A marketing team doesn't pick a WordPress agency because an ad caught them mid-scroll. They pick one when a rebrand, migration, or stuck launch forces the search. These channels also need huge audiences, and 'marketing leaders choosing an agency right now' is too small a slice to target.
card4_body: The only channel that scores green on the requirement that matters most: it puts IT Monks in front of a marketing leader the moment they search for an agency.
